title: Can Graph Learning Learn Circuits?
abstract: arXiv:2608.08536v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Circuit localization is a mechanistic interpretability task whose goal is to identify a sparse subgraph of a transformer's computation graph sufficient to reproduce a particular behavior. Most established methods localize circuits independently for each model-task pair. We instead frame circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem in which the edges of a computation graph represent computational pathways, and graph neural networks (GNNs) model interactions among these pathways. We introduce Graph Circuit Learning (GCL), a supervised, amortized framework that trains a GNN across multiple model-task pairs and applies it to unseen cases. To provide sufficient data, we augment the InterpBench benchmark with additional cases derived from TracrBench programs. Of the 46 evaluated GCL configurations, the one selected by cross-validation scored a median edge AUROC of 0.946 (interquartile interval [0.841, 0.980]) on the 16 held-out

translated_abstract: 电路定位是一项机制可解释性任务，其目标是识别变换器计算图中足以重现特定行为的稀疏子图。大多数已有方法针对每个模型-任务对独立地定位电路。我们转而将电路定位表述为一个图机器学习问题，其中计算图的边表示计算路径，图神经网络（GNN）对这些路径之间的交互进行建模。我们提出了图电路学习（GCL），这是一个有监督的、摊销式框架，它在多个模型-任务对上训练GNN，并将其应用于未见过的案例。为了提供充足的数据，我们利用源自TracrBench程序的额外案例扩充了InterpBench基准。在评估的46种GCL配置中，由交叉验证选出的配置在16个留出案例上取得了0.946的中位数边AUROC（四分位区间为[0.841, 0.980]）。
tldr: 本文提出图电路学习（GCL）框架，首次将机制可解释性中的电路定位任务转化为图机器学习问题，通过图神经网络在多个模型-任务对上进行有监督的摊销式训练并泛化到未见案例，在留出案例上取得了0.946的中位数边AUROC。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Graph Circuit Learning (GCL), a novel supervised, amortized framework that reformulates circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem, training GNNs across multiple model-task pairs to generalize to unseen cases and achieving a median edge AUROC of 0.946 on held-out cases.
